data.subject: Application for Internship Opportunity
data.body:
Dear Arhaam

I hope you are doing well.

I am writing to express my interest in the internship opportunity at your
organization. I am eager to gain practical experience, enhance my skills,
and contribute meaningfully to your team. With a strong willingness to
learn and a commitment to delivering quality work, I am confident that I
can add value while growing professionally.

I would appreciate the opportunity to further discuss how my skills and
enthusiasm align with your current needs. Please let me know if there are
any additional documents or information required from my side.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to your response.

Best regards,
Hunain
